Receive an incoming packet

Source: R/peer_chat.R
peer_receive.Rd

Waits for an incoming UDP packet with the given timeout. Automatically processes the packet (e.g., stores newly discovered peers, prints received messages).

Usage

peer_receive(timeout_ms = 100L)

Arguments

timeout_ms

Integer. Maximum time to wait in milliseconds. Use 0 for non-blocking. Default is 100.

Value

Integer. The packet type on success (>=0), or -1 on timeout or error.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
packet_type <- peer_receive(100)
} # }
